subject.title: fix(k8s): scope --delete to OpenClaw resources instead of the whole namespace

question: Should the safety fix intentionally change existing `--delete` automation to preserve the namespace by default, with operators updating scripts to add `--delete-namespace` when full namespace deletion is intended?
rationale: The proposed default prevents deletion of unrelated workloads, but it also changes a documented public CLI behavior that existing operators may have automated.

options.title: Adopt the safe default
options.body: Make `--delete` resource-scoped, require the explicit paired namespace flag for the legacy destructive behavior, and clearly document the automation upgrade.

options.title: Preserve legacy deletion by default
options.body: Keep namespace deletion as the meaning of `--delete` and pursue a different shared-namespace safety workflow.

recommendation.title: Adopt the safe default
recommendation.body: Make `--delete` resource-scoped, require the explicit paired namespace flag for the legacy destructive behavior, and clearly document the automation upgrade.

likelyOwner.reason: Low-confidence routing candidate for deployment-script behavior and the public CLI compatibility decision.
